change.after: "Kafka Connect configuration stored in the ConfigMap created by the operator"

consequence.statement: Environments using Kafka Connect continue to work, but the Connect configuration now lives in the ConfigMap created by the operator rather than its previous location; operators should verify their configuration setup.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, the Kafka Connect configuration was moved to the ConfigMap created by the operator; environments using Kafka Connect are affected and should review where their Connect configuration lives.
